## Dependencies that changed after your training data

Your training data (`claude-sonnet-4-5`, cutoff 2025-07-31) predates the versions this project pins. When a note below conflicts with what you remember, follow the note: it describes the installed version. Tags: [types] = diff of the published type declarations, [changelog] = release notes, [guide] = the package's upgrade guide, [summary] = summary of both.

**next** 15.4.0 → 16.4.2 (major)
- `NextConfig` keys that moved (deprecated ones still type-check): `experimental.turbo` → `turbopack`; `experimental.{ppr, cacheComponents, dynamicIO, useCache}` → `cacheComponents`; `experimental.cacheLife` → `cacheLife` (+11 more). [types]
  Before: `experimental: { ppr: true },` → After: `cacheComponents: true,` (type-checked)
- `NextConfig` options removed: `eslint`, `amp`, `publicRuntimeConfig`, `serverRuntimeConfig`. [types]
  Before: `publicRuntimeConfig: { apiUrl: process.env.API_URL },` → After: `env: { NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: process.env.API_URL },` (type-checked)
- On `NextConfig`, deprecated: `skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize` (use `skipProxyUrlNormalize`) [types]
  Before: `skipMiddlewareUrlNormalize: true,` → After: `skipProxyUrlNormalize: true,` (type-checked)
- [breaking]: enable clientSegmentCache by default. [changelog]
- BREAKING CHANGE!: next/image only allow quality 75 by default. [changelog]
- The `images.qualities` default changed from allowing any quality to only `[75]`. Other `quality` props are coerced to the nearest allowed value, and `/_next/image` requests with other `q` values return 400. List every quality you need, for example `images.qualities: [50, 75, 100]`. [guide]
- The `images.minimumCacheTTL` default changed from `60` seconds to `14400` (4 hours). Set `images.minimumCacheTTL: 60` to keep the old revalidation interval. [guide]
- Local `next/image` sources with query strings, such as `/assets/photo?v=1`, are now rejected unless they match an `images.localPatterns` entry with a `search` value, for example `{ pathname: '/assets/**', search: '?v=1' }`. [guide]

**typescript** 5.8.3 → 7.0.2 (major)
- `CompilerOptions` options removed: `allowSyntheticDefaultImports`, `alwaysStrict`, `baseUrl`, `charset`, `downlevelIteration`, `importsNotUsedAsValues`, `keyofStringsOnly`, `noStrictGenericChecks` (+7 more). [types]
- Since 6.0, `rootDir` defaults to the directory containing `tsconfig.json` instead of being inferred from the common source directory. Output lands in `dist/src/index.js` unless you set `"rootDir": "./src"` explicitly, or `"../src"` when including files outside the tsconfig directory. [guide]
- `baseUrl` is gone and no longer acts as a module lookup root. Remove it and prefix each `paths` entry instead, e.g. `"@app/*": ["./src/app/*"]`. Add `"*": ["./src/*"]` only if bare imports really relied on `baseUrl` lookup. [guide]
- `moduleResolution: node` (alias `node10`) is deprecated in 6.0 and removed in 7.0. Use `nodenext` for Node.js, or `bundler` for bundlers and Bun; `bundler` may now be combined with `module: commonjs`. [guide]
- `moduleResolution: classic` has been removed. Use `nodenext` or `bundler`. [guide]
- `noUncheckedSideEffectImports` now defaults to `true`, so side-effect imports like `import "./styles.css"` must resolve. Set it to `false` to keep the old behavior. [guide]
- `esModuleInterop` and `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` can no longer be `false`; interop is always on. Write `import express from "express"` instead of `import * as express from "express"`. [guide]
- The `module` values `amd`, `umd`, `systemjs` and `none` are no longer supported, and `/// <amd-module>` has no effect. Emit ESM (`esnext`/`preserve`) or `commonjs` and use a bundler. [guide]

**react** 19.1.0 → 19.3.1
- Since React 19, render errors are no longer re-thrown. Uncaught errors go to `window.reportError` and errors caught by a boundary go to `console.error`. If error reporting relied on re-throws, pass `onUncaughtError`/`onCaughtError` options to `createRoot`/`hydrateRoot`. [guide]
- `defaultProps` on function components no longer applies, so props stay undefined. Use ES6 default parameters instead, like `function Heading({text = 'Hello'})`. `defaultProps` still works on class components. [guide]
- `propTypes` checks are removed from React and are silently ignored, so they give no runtime validation. Use TypeScript types instead. [guide]
- `ReactDOM.render` is removed. Use `createRoot(el).render(<App />)` from `react-dom/client`. [guide]
- `ReactDOM.hydrate` is removed. Use `hydrateRoot(container, <App />)` from `react-dom/client`, which takes the container argument first. [guide]
- `unmountComponentAtNode` is removed. Keep the root object and call `root.unmount()` instead. [guide]
- Transitions now render independently instead of being entangled into a single render, so a slow transition no longer holds up unrelated ones (@acdlite ) [changelog]
